findings.detail: Requested model and echoed response model are jev-1.13.0 on all five status-200 calls; this upgrades the pin from assertion to response-echo evidence at the captured receipt layer. It is not an independent server audit.

Five status-200 calls have varying input usage 439/444/438/434/420, uniform output 20, typed Noul answers, and probabilities 0.94/0.48/0.06/0.02/0.70. The first two reproduce Partial2 values independently. The receipt ceiling is accepted: no response ID/timestamp means no external request correlation.

The absent-field statement is honest as written: every captured response body has response_id=null and timestamp=null, and the receipt states it checked answers/model/usage. This proves absence from captured JSON bodies, not absence from unrequested headers or server metadata.
No provenance blocker remains for rung3 at the stated ceiling. Remaining limits are explicit: no response ID/timestamp and N=5 is not calibration evidence; neither is a new provenance hold.

standing_limits: No server response ID/timestamp is available for external correlation.
N=5 does not establish accuracy, coverage, or calibration.
Do not call this production safety certification.
